// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the lint MUST reject this.
// The `email` and `display_name` fields carry PII but are NOT #[personal_data(...)]-tagged:
// the un-erasable / un-mapped subject bug class (ADR-12). They escape the crypto-shred erase
// and the RoPA/data-map fan-out.
pub struct Principal {
    pub id: PrincipalId,
    pub email: String,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub region: Region,
}
